features.text: GetSupportedConversionTypes: Returns all supported conversion types (GET /conversion/formats)
GetDocumentMetadata: Returns metadata for provided document (GET /conversion/info)
ConvertDocument: Converts specified input document to format specified in the convertSettings with specified options (POST /conversion)
ConvertDocumentDirect: Converts input document file to format specified (PUT /conversion)
StartConvertAndSave: Starts async conversion specified input document to format specified in the convertSettings with specified options (POST /conversion/async)
StartConvert: Starts async conversion specified input document, from request body, to format specified (PUT /conversion/async)
